common.javascriptRequired: JavaScript is required to use FOCUSON HRMS.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your company Employee ID.
login.forgotDescription: Contact your HR administrator. For your security, only an authorised administrator can reset your password. You will be asked to choose a new password after signing in.
login.required: Enter your Employee ID and password.
login.accessHelp: Access is managed by your HR administrator.
login.footer: Authorised use only. Activity is security audited.
login.configMissing: The secure API is not configured. Follow docs/DEPLOYMENT.md and add the Apps Script Web App URL to assets/js/config.js.
login.configUnavailable: Company branding could not be loaded. You can still try signing in; check your connection if the problem continues.

app.idleLogout: You were signed out after a period of inactivity.
app.loggedOutAll: All devices have been signed out.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your account and current security session.
dashboard.logoutAllDescription: This revokes every active session for your account, including this browser. You will need your Employee ID and password to sign in again.
dashboard.moduleStatusDescription: The navigation and available actions are derived from your current server-verified access. Contact HR if your responsibilities have changed.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Your current information from the company employee master.
profile.privacyNotice: Contact HR to correct your employee record. Sensitive financial, government ID and medical fields are protected separately and are not displayed on this screen.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.description: Your new password must contain at least {min} characters.
changePassword.complexity: Use uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a symbol. Do not reuse a password used elsewhere.
changePassword.lengthOnly: Use a unique password that is not used for any other account.
changePassword.tooShort: The new password must contain at least {min} characters.
changePassword.mismatch: The new password and confirmation do not match.
changePassword.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current password.
changePassword.complexityError: Include uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a symbol.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address does not match an available screen. Use the navigation to continue.

forbidden.title: Access not granted
forbidden.description: Your current roles do not include access to this screen. Contact HR if you believe this is incorrect.

errors.pageTitle: This screen could not be loaded
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.VALIDATION: Check the information entered and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested record or action was not found.
errors.LOCKED: The service is busy with another update. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errors.CONFLICT: The record changed or this request was already processed. Refresh and try again.
errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.CONFIGURATION: The Apps Script API URL is missing or invalid. Check assets/js/config.js.
errors.SERVER: The request could not be completed. Try again or contact your administrator.
errors.STARTUP: The application could not start. Refresh the page and check your connection.
